senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="Q01111">same</cite> <cite ref="Nedarim 38a:6">Ned. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ בעלמא</he> only deductions by argument (were given to Moses exclusively, and he communicated them to the people).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 4:3:8">Y. Ter. IV, 42ᵈ</cite> <he>מפִּילְפּוּל חבירייא שמעית הא</he> I learned this from the students’ arguments.
<cite ref="Eruvin 67a:4">Erub. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>רב ששת מרתע</he> … <he>מפִּילְפּוּלֵיה וכ׳</he> R. Sh. trembled all over his body, when R. H. argued.

<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:18">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>אם … מהדרני ליה מפִּילְפּוּלִי</he> if, God forefend, the Law should be forgotten in Israel, I could restore it by my argumentation; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
